subject: StratusWorks marketplace voucher curation & activation plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusworks.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Promotional vouchers for StratusWorks marketplace listing

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the run through earlier. StratusWorks is moving our marketplace listing to pilot next month and our partner team would like to provide promotional vouchers to the first set of customers who onboard through the listing. High-level asks:

- Can Redwood provide partner-sourced promotional credits (marketplace-funded or promo codes) to support up to ~50 customers during the pilot?
- Prefer vouchers applied at provisioning time (marketplace credit strongly preferred over manual codes)
- Looking for guidance on activation timeline, per-customer limits, and any restrictions we need to include in the offer T&Cs.

I attached a short partner requirements doc that summarizes our expected customer personas and estimated spend per customer. Can you tell us next steps and what details you need from our side to scope the voucher batch?

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | StratusWorks
elena@stratusworks.io

Attachment: partner_requirements.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusworks.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional vouchers for StratusWorks marketplace listing

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the context and the doc. Short answers up front: yes, we can support partner-sourced vouchers tied to a marketplace listing; marketplace-credited vouchers are preferable for onboarding hygiene.

A few clarifying items we need so we can scope the allocation and finalize ops:
- Target number of customers and per-customer credit amount (e.g., $1,000 credit for 50 customers vs $2,000 for 25)
- Whether credits should expire (we typically do 90–180 days for pilot offers)
- Would StratusWorks prefer single-use codes or a managed marketplace credit that automatically applies on provisioning?

Looping in Ben from Partner Ops and Marissa on GTM incentives so we can propose a firm allocation and timeline. I also uploaded our voucher CSV template — please populate the eligible SKU/plan IDs and preferred credit amounts in the template and return it to us. Once Ben confirms capacity, we can route the activation runbook to your marketplace contact.

Next step: Elena, if you can return the filled voucher_template.csv by EOD Friday, Ben will draft the activation schedule and we can aim for a 2-week turnaround for marketplace activation pending legal and finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachment: voucher_template.csv (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional vouchers for StratusWorks marketplace listing

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 11:03 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the context and the doc. Short answers up front: yes, we can support partner-sourced vouchers tied to a marketplace listing; marketplace-credited vouchers are preferable for onboarding hygiene.

Thanks — quick ops note from my side. My recommendation:

- Proposal: 50 vouchers at $1,500 each (total face value $75k), 120-day expiry from activation.
- Activation mechanism: Marketplace-allocated credits (preferred). If the marketplace partner cannot support credit objects, fall back to single-use promo codes delivered via the marketplace listing.
- Per-customer limit: 1 voucher per account to prevent double-dipping.
- Budget owner: Redwood Partner Promotions (PO #PP-2026-1197). Finance will need this PO tied to the deal id.

If that allocation is acceptable, I will start the capacity check and prepare the runbook for activation windows. Sergio, can you confirm the typical lead time for a marketplace credit rollout and whether we need a DocuSign MOU upfront?

Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional vouchers for StratusWorks marketplace listing

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 10:12 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposal: 50 vouchers at $1,500 each (total face value $75k), 120-day expiry from activation.

This looks good from Marketplace Ops POV. Notes:
- Typical lead time to publish credit-backed offers on the marketplace is ~7 business days after we have the voucher manifest and legal signoff.
- We should capture the activation window in the DocuSign MOU to avoid any ambiguity about start/end dates. I'll attach the activation runbook for your review — it includes the CSV format we need and a checklist for the marketplace partner.
- Legal: we need to confirm the T&Cs for customer liability and refunds; request Legal (cc not on this thread) to review MOU quickly.

Proposed timeline if we get the filled CSV by Friday:
1) Wed-Thu: Legal & Finance signoff (DocuSign)
2) Next Mon: Publish offer + staging activation for QA
3) Next Tue: Go-live on marketplace

Attaching activation_runbook.md (contains CSV example, activation API endpoints, and rollback steps). Ben — I can take point on publishing once the MOU is executed.

Sergio Alvarez
Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: activation_runbook.md (stub)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@stratusworks.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudmarketplace.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional vouchers for StratusWorks marketplace listing

Hi team —

Thanks, everyone — we accept the proposed allocation and timeline. We will fill the voucher_template.csv with 50 rows at $1,500 each and set expiry at 120 days. I will route the DocuSign MOU to our procurement team today and ask them to add Redwood as counterparty.

One operational note: our first pilot customer (Acme Analytics) expects to onboard next Wednesday — if the timing holds, they'll be among the earliest to receive the credits. Please route any DocuSign link to my procurement contact (paul.nguyen@cloudmarketplace.com) so they can complete signatures quickly.

I'll upload the filled CSV and the signed MOU link when available.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | StratusWorks

Attachment pending: signed_partner_mou.pdf (will upload after signature)
